name: marketingskills_prompts
description: Reusable prompt pack derived from the marketingskills capability.

prompts.name: seo_optimization_prompt
prompts.template: Optimize the following marketing content for SEO using these keywords: {seo_keywords}. Content: {marketing_content}
prompts.use_case: Automated generation of SEO-optimized marketing copy for AI agents

prompts.name: conversion_rate_optimization_prompt
prompts.template: Suggest improvements to increase conversion rates in this campaign content: {marketing_content}. Include CRO best practices.
prompts.use_case: Data-driven conversion rate optimization for digital campaigns

prompts.name: analytics_reporting_prompt
prompts.template: Analyze this marketing analytics data and generate a performance report: {analytics_data}
prompts.use_case: Analytical insights production for marketing performance evaluation

prompts.name: growth_strategy_prompt
prompts.template: Develop a growth engineering strategy based on these business objectives: {growth_objectives}
prompts.use_case: Strategic growth engineering assistance for startups and businesses
